info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Airline Flights Miles-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Mileage Information API provides access to detailed mileage data for various airline flights. It enables users to retrieve essential information regarding the miles earned on flights, which can be valuable for travelers looking to manage their loyalty programs effectively. Common consumers of this API include travel agencies, airline partners, and mobile travel apps that aim to offer mileage tracking features. This API streamlines the process of obtaining flight-related mileage insights, supporting enhanced customer experiences in travel-related services.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain detailed mileage information for flights, including accumulated miles and associated benefits. Ideal for travelers looking to track their mileage points.
